# Data Source: stripe_apps_install

An installation of a Stripe App on the account, with the permissions, endpoints and content security policy its installer granted. Look one up by its `id`. `auth_code` is sensitive and is stored in the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_apps_install" "reporting" {
  id = "appinst_1Nv0FGQ9RKHgCVdK"
}

output "reporting_permissions" {
  value = data.stripe_apps_install.reporting.permissions_granted
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the apps install to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `account` - The ID of the account that the app install belongs to.
* `app` - The ID of the app installed.
* `approval_required` - Whether the installer must authorize pending permissions, content security policy entries, or endpoints. For private apps, `approval_required` stays `false`; creating or reauthorizing the install through the API installs the newest completed upload and grants its permissions.
* `auth_code` - (Sensitive) The authorization code for an oauth app install.
* `channel` - The distribution channel associated with the app install. Possible values: `private_live`, `private_test`, `public`, `review`, `testing`.
* `content_security_policy_granted` - See [`content_security_policy_granted`](#content_security_policy_granted) below.
* `content_security_policy_pending` - See [`content_security_policy_pending`](#content_security_policy_pending) below.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `created_by` - The ID of the embedding platform that created the install, if applicable.
* `endpoints_granted` - The endpoint URLs authorized by the installer.
* `endpoints_pending` - The endpoint URLs requested by the latest app version that the installer has not authorized.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `permissions_granted` - The permissions authorized by the installer.
* `permissions_pending` - The permissions requested by the latest app version that the installer has not authorized.
* `status` - The status of the app install. Possible values: `install_failed`, `installed`, `installing`, `uninstall_failed`, `uninstalling`.

<a id="content_security_policy_granted"></a>
### `content_security_policy_granted`

The `content_security_policy_granted` attribute supports:

* `connect_src` - The URLs that the app can make network requests to.
* `image_src` - The URLs that the app can load images from.

<a id="content_security_policy_pending"></a>
### `content_security_policy_pending`

The `content_security_policy_pending` attribute supports:

* `connect_src` - The URLs that the app can make network requests to.
* `image_src` - The URLs that the app can load images from.
